description: Check a checkout created by create_checkout and, once it is paid, return the delivery link for a digital product. `state` is where the checkout stands – open, expired, clearing (complete, payment not yet cleared) or settled – and `paid` is true exactly when it is settled. A settled checkout carries `delivery`: `ships` is a parcel, with nothing to download; `ready` returns `accessUrl`, the permanent download page; `claim` returns `claimUrl`, because this call beat the order being minted, and opening claimUrl mints it and lands on the same download page. Call it after handing the person the checkout URL – leave a few seconds between calls, it is not a busy-wait. Requires the session_id create_checkout returned: orders cannot be listed, searched, or looked up by email, and no personal data (email, name, address) is ever returned.
name: get_order
title: Check order status
